test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 10 Jan 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: With the success of the anti-satellite (ASAT) test in 2019, with which other countries did India join the league?
solution:
The correct answer is **US, Russia, China.**

__
 
• ‘Mission Shakti’ was the country’s **first-ever Anti-Satellite (ASAT) Missile Test **successfully conducted on 27th March 2019 from Dr AP J Abdul Kalam Island in Odisha, where a fast-moving Indian orbiting target satellite in** Low Earth Orbit (LEO) was neutralised with pinpoint accuracy. **
 
• This was a highly complex mission, conducted at extremely high speed with remarkable precision.
 
• The successful conduct of Mission Shakti was made **India the fourth nation in the world after US, Russia, China​ **with the capability to defend its assets in outer space.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Countries that have launched Anti-satellite missions:
 
 
• **Russia PL-19**
 
• **China SC-19 **
 
• **The United States of America USA-193**
